“These Ninth Rank Alien Race…if I wanted to kill them now, I could do so at any time,” Lin Yuan’s heart suddenly stirred.

Inside the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, any outsider would be suppressed; the inability to instantaneously move was just one aspect, and their perception would also drastically plummet.

Therefore, under normal circumstances, as long as a Ninth Rank Alien wasn’t too conspicuous and honestly hid in some corner, there wouldn’t be any danger.

“Forget it, it’s better to appear ordinary,” Lin Yuan still gave up the tempting idea.

He absolutely couldn’t leave any traces of controlling the Xuanhuang Secret Realm and becoming this realm’s new owner.

...

Precisely locating each Ninth Rank Alien and pursuing them for kills? That would no longer just be a question of strength.

The Six-Armed Silhouette had informed Lin Yuan long ago that every time the Xuanhuang Secret Realm opened, it would be under the scrutiny of Supreme Beings.

In such a situation, it’s better to keep a low profile. If Lin Yuan could become a Supreme Being in the future, what would it matter if he openly claimed to be the owner of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm?

“According to the current speed of refining, in about five more years, I should be able to completely refine it,” he thought as he continued to look at the Core of the Secret Realm in front of him. Without the “Mysterious Yellow Strike,” it would take at least twenty years to refine the Core of the Secret Realm.

With the help of the “Mysterious Yellow Strike,” the time consumed was significantly reduced.

In fact, the amount of time it took to refine the Core of the Secret Realm didn’t mean much to Lin Yuan.

After becoming the ‘Xuanhuang’ Emperor’s successor and starting to refine the Core of the Secret Realm, Lin Yuan gained the “permission” to enter the Xuanhuang Secret Realm at any time.

There was no need to wait until the Xuanhuang Secret Realm opened to enter.

As long as Lin Yuan willed it, he could enter the Xuanhuang Secret Realm by using the Xuanhuang Seal.

“However, I can’t take the initiative against those Ninth Rank Alien Race. But soon, the Ninth Rank Evolvers from human civilization within the secret realm will begin to clear out and drive away all hostile Ninth Rank Alien Race, and then it will be no problem for me to make a move.”

Lin Yuan silently thought to himself.

With human civilization as cover, as long as Lin Yuan was careful, he should not reveal anything.

As for exhibiting combat power that surpasses common understanding? Compared with the entire Xuanhuang Secret Realm, what did that amount to?

In fact, Lin Yuan’s current talent and the title of human civilization’s first ever genius Evolver and so on hadn’t attracted too much attention from the different species’ Supreme Beings.

To these alien Supreme Beings, as long as Lin Yuan hadn’t stepped into the Twelfth Rank, he was just a ‘pitiful creature’ in the River of Time, destined to one day reach the end of his lifespan and be on the verge of death.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan was fully dedicated to comprehending the “Mysterious Yellow Strike.”

Among the three great Dao-Protecting Secret Skills of the Profound Yellow Lineage, the “Xuanhuang Physique” required a large amount of Xuanhuang Crystals and was temporarily unfeasible to cultivate.

The “Steps of Space and Time” was a secret technique for escaping, but Lin Yuan currently felt no pressure. His true body was stationed at the Milky Way Main Star. Within the territory of human civilization, under the watchful eyes of the Supreme Beings, to say he was absolutely safe was not an exaggeration.

The Taiyin Primordial Spirit was on Medium-Sized Otherworldly Battlefield B0001, absorbing World-Breaking Origin Force that overflowed from the Eternal Spatial Rift, unaware of Lin Yuan Taiyin Primordial Spirit’s true identity.

And with the power of the Taiyin Primordial Spirit, hiding in one of the Medium-Sized Otherworldly Battlefields was as stable as it could get.

As for the Taiyang Divine Spirit, it had now become the half-owner of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm; in some ways, even the Supreme Beings couldn’t do anything about it.

There was temporarily no need for the “Steps of Space and Time.”

“It’s truly worthy of being one of the Profound Yellow Lineage’s three great Dao-Protecting Secret Skills. With my current speed of comprehension, to reach Perfection, it seems it’ll take decades…” Lin Yuan expressed in a tone of astonishment, unaware that even an Eleventh-Rank Life would need more than seven thousand years to cultivate this secret technique to its Third Stage.

As for completing all Four Stages? Without tens of thousands of years, it simply couldn’t be done.

“However, if I can step into Tier 10 within ten years, perhaps reaching Perfection won’t take much time?” Lin Yuan pondered internally.

The Against-Heaven’s Understanding Lin Yuan possessed completely depended on the heights he achieved; the one at Ninth Rank was a completely different concept from that at Tenth Rank.

While he was at Ninth Rank, Lin Yuan would need to spend decades or even a hundred years to cultivate the “Mysterious Yellow Strike” to Perfection. Upon reaching Tenth Rank, it was estimated that only a few years or even months would be needed.

And if he reached Tier 11, perhaps mastering the “Mysterious Yellow Strike” to Perfection would be a matter of counting days?

“Take it slow.”

“I have plenty of time.”

Details of the “Mysterious Yellow Strike” surfaced in Lin Yuan’s mind as he continued to immerse himself in cultivation.

…

Time passed.

In the blink of an eye, four years had gone by.

On another continent in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, Lin Yuan’s figure appeared out of nowhere, while countless indigenous life forms below remained completely unaware of his presence.

“At most, one more year is left before I can completely refine the Core of the Secret Realm,” Lin Yuan revealed a smile, although he faced no time restrictions within the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

He didn’t need to leave like the other Ninth Rank Aliens when the time came, or else he would be ‘erased’ by the Secret Realm itself.

But the sooner he refined the Core of the Secret Realm, the better.

“In these four years, the Second Stage of the ‘Mysterious Yellow Strike’ is almost perfected,” Lin Yuan shook his head slightly, somewhat dissatisfied.

In actuality, this rate of cultivation was already astonishing, even terrifying.

It’s likely that throughout the Profound Yellow Lineage’s history, no successor has ever managed to cultivate this secret technique to the Second Stage in less than a decade.

Truly, as if a strike that reaches three times one’s own limit of strength is as common as cabbage on the roadside and easy to master?

But for Lin Yuan, it was still a bit slow for just one secret technique.

“Hmm?”

“The Ninth Rank Evolvers from human civilization have started to blockade the outer areas?” Lin Yuan looked up, his gaze penetrating layers of void, landing on another continent.
